items.title: Polymarket and Kalshi hold 97 percent of U.S. prediction market demand as category index grows 2.35 times in a year, AffRoom reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket and Kalshi hold 97 percent of U.S. prediction market demand as category index grows 2.35 times in a year, AffRoom reports** — AffRoom's guide, using a Blask export dated October 1, 2026, said Polymarket held 71.5 percent and Kalshi 25.6 percent of the combined index of the ten largest U.S. prediction market brands from October 2025 to August 2026, with every other brand below 1 percent. items.title: CFTC sues Utah and Attorney General Derek Brown in tenth state fight over prediction market jurisdiction, CoinCentral reports
items.content_text: - **CFTC sues Utah and Attorney General Derek Brown in tenth state fight over prediction market jurisdiction, CoinCentral reports** — CoinCentral reported the CFTC filed suit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah against Utah and Attorney General Derek Brown, arguing the state is intruding on federal authority over prediction markets. Utah had sued Kalshi seeking to recover up to 60 million dollars, and the CFTC said the event contracts at issue are swaps on CFTC-regulated designated contract markets. ([CoinCentral](https://coincentral.com/cftc-sues-utah-to-protect-kalshi-and-prediction-markets/))
